figures.before: What "Self-Perform" Means in the GC World — and What It Means for You as a Subcontractor
figures.alt: Concrete pour preparation with rebar, vapor barrier, edge forms, and a clean ready-to-place slab area
figures.caption: Self-perform scopes affect how the job is sequenced, supervised, staffed, and handed to the specialty trades. Clear boundaries and coordination matter more than a broad label.

figures.before: The JK Trade Partner Vetting Process: What You Need Before First Mobilization
figures.alt: Contractor qualification documents, insurance verification, and a blank checklist organized on a clean desk
figures.caption: Before mobilization, a trade partner should have clear scope, insurance, safety expectations, schedule requirements, points of contact, submittal needs, site rules, and the documents needed to start responsibly.

figures.alt: Construction planning table with drawings, measuring tools, a blank clipboard, and coordination materials
figures.caption: Trade coordination is a daily construction process. The work needs a shared plan for sequence, deliveries, manpower, quality, safety, inspections, changes, dependencies, and closeout.
